significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish a form-(iii) relation: across reasoning tasks, a self-constructed discrete code can "match or exceed natural-language chain-of-thought while being more token-efficient," with performance causally depending on symbol meanings and partially transferring between models. This combines a substantial phenomenon—accuracy/token-efficiency under a non-natural grammar—with a mechanistic decomposition between informative symbolic structure and mere extra computation; Wei et al. (2022) made natural-language CoT a standard substrate, while Goyal et al. (ICLR 2024) and Hao et al.'s COCONUT (ICLR 2025) make the choice among pause-token, continuous, and explicit symbolic substrates consequential for explanations of reasoning. The outcomes are determinate, but the negative branch would only rule out useful self-invented dialects for the covered model/task class rather than prove natural language necessary, and mixed outcomes could weaken the broad conclusion. Topic substitution leaves only the generic language–intelligence question and none of the asserted efficiency, corruption, or transfer relations, so the score comes from this claim rather than the topic baseline.

reach.justification: The principal handle is the "legend mapping recurrent reasoning operations/objects to short invented symbols," together with the measurable "accuracy-per-token efficiency" and "shared-structure transfer score." It is ex ante: the dialect is supplied as a decode-time reasoning interface before answers are produced, giving model builders an action window to reduce inference tokens rather than merely explain errors afterward. The hypothesis asserts transfer "across problems/models" and predicts that re-inventing or importing such a dialect should recover the accuracy-efficiency relation, although exact symbols may remain model-specific; likely downstream users therefore include inference-system designers and deployers, not only researchers analyzing the phenomenon. Under topic substitution, the broad language–intelligence question supplies neither this usable notation nor its forward-looking efficiency rule, so the reach is specific to the claim.
